param.name: param
param.synopsis: Slider -> asemic/value/<id>.value. kw: step curve label anim mode depth channel
param.doc: Slider -> asemic/value/<id>.value. kw: step curve label anim mode depth channel

multi.name: multi
multi.synopsis: Multislider (param array) -> asemic/value/<id>.<i>, i = 0..n (default 8, max 64); each index routable as '<id>.<i>'. kw: step curve label
multi.doc: Multislider (param array) -> asemic/value/<id>.<i>, i = 0..n (default 8, max 64); each index routable as '<id>.<i>'. kw: step curve label

xy.name: xy
xy.synopsis: XY pad -> asemic/value/<id>.{x,y}. kw: label anim mode(drift) depth channel
xy.doc: XY pad -> asemic/value/<id>.{x,y}. kw: label anim mode(drift) depth channel

proc.name: proc
proc.synopsis: Processor / signal generator -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id> (point multiarray). proc: physics wave spectrum glyph (text=...) melody (voices base beats step slow; dims pitch dur) variations py (fn in the REPL via @proc(id, 'py'); brain sends params + input gen on change, caches reply) lsys (axiom=, rules='0.5: F -> F[+F]F; ...', n angle step growth; input=<gen id> roots a tree per point, stride, scale, scale_by=<attr>) text (text=, path=<font file, hot reload>, x y size + axis tags e.g. wght as params) chaos perlin simplex lfo random-walk white gauss; input = key (io stream / 'chaos:x' / 'gain'); other kw = params
proc.doc: Processor / signal generator -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id> (point multiarray). proc: physics wave spectrum glyph (text=...) melody (voices base beats step slow; dims pitch dur) variations py (fn in the REPL via @proc(id, 'py'); brain sends params + input gen on change, caches reply) lsys (axiom=, rules='0.5: F -> F[+F]F; ...', n angle step growth; input=<gen id> roots a tree per point, stride, scale, scale_by=<attr>) text (text=, path=<font file, hot reload>, x y size + axis tags e.g. wght as params) chaos perlin simplex lfo random-walk white gauss; input = key (io stream / 'chaos:x' / 'gain'); other kw = params

vfont.name: vfont
vfont.synopsis: live=True: rebuild on master component/param changes (debounced, <= hz/s, default 10, latest only; block owns it). Variable font from glyph procs: masters = >= 2 glyph proc ids (seed + params; param stroke = outline width, font units, 60), chars (default 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'; asemic font has no lowercase), dir ('fonts'); writes UFOs + designspace (norad), compiles <dir>/<name>.ttf (fontc), axis ASMC 0..n-1; announces asemic/state/vfont/<name>; returns path. proc('t', 'text', path=..) hot-reloads it, ASMC routable
vfont.doc: live=True: rebuild on master component/param changes (debounced, <= hz/s, default 10, latest only; block owns it). Variable font from glyph procs: masters = >= 2 glyph proc ids (seed + params; param stroke = outline width, font units, 60), chars (default 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'; asemic font has no lowercase), dir ('fonts'); writes UFOs + designspace (norad), compiles <dir>/<name>.ttf (fontc), axis ASMC 0..n-1; announces asemic/state/vfont/<name>; returns path. proc('t', 'text', path=..) hot-reloads it, ASMC routable

set.name: set
set.synopsis: set('gain', .5) / set('arena', 'x', .2) / set('arena.x', .2); paths relative to the block: 'm.n', '../m.n', '/t/m.n'
set.doc: set('gain', .5) / set('arena', 'x', .2) / set('arena.x', .2); paths relative to the block: 'm.n', '../m.n', '/t/m.n'

route.name: route
route.synopsis: route('gain', 'supercollider.set.freq', frm=(0,1), to=(40,2000)); src 'chaos:vx' = noise channel. kw: combine='replace'|'add'|'multiply' (plugtype vs dst's current value)
route.doc: route('gain', 'supercollider.set.freq', frm=(0,1), to=(40,2000)); src 'chaos:vx' = noise channel. kw: combine='replace'|'add'|'multiply' (plugtype vs dst's current value)

ui.name: ui
ui.synopsis: UI/perf settings (asemic_schema::UiSettings -> asemic/state/ui): image=auto|quad|halfcell|tgp|sixel|unicode hz=20 clock=True; no kw = return current
ui.doc: UI/perf settings (asemic_schema::UiSettings -> asemic/state/ui): image=auto|quad|halfcell|tgp|sixel|unicode hz=20 clock=True; no kw = return current

drop.name: drop
drop.synopsis: Remove everything a block label created
drop.doc: Remove everything a block label created

output.name: output
output.synopsis: Open output (request/response; block owns it): kind syphon -> Syphon server asemic:<name> (w x h), draws src gen ids (str/list) with the asemic-repl line brush; post = none / feedback (asemic-repl main.wgsl); brush = line/curve/dot; width/alpha/brightness/position = WGSL modifier bodies (info: ModifierInfo); jack + src = x/y oscilloscope audio (out_1 x, out_2 y), drawing traced hz times/s (60); failed reopen keeps the old output; syphon outputs stream asemic/preview/<name> (~10 fps, <=160x90) only while subscribed (view(name, kind='frame')); kind jack -> JACK client asemic-<name>, w = channels; outputs() reports clients + visible; node = publish a texture node (tex) instead of src
output.doc: Open output (request/response; block owns it): kind syphon -> Syphon server asemic:<name> (w x h), draws src gen ids (str/list) with the asemic-repl line brush; post = none / feedback (asemic-repl main.wgsl); brush = line/curve/dot; width/alpha/brightness/position = WGSL modifier bodies (info: ModifierInfo); jack + src = x/y oscilloscope audio (out_1 x, out_2 y), drawing traced hz times/s (60); failed reopen keeps the old output; syphon outputs stream asemic/preview/<name> (~10 fps, <=160x90) only while subscribed (view(name, kind='frame')); kind jack -> JACK client asemic-<name>, w = channels; outputs() reports clients + visible; node = publish a texture node (tex) instead of src

tex.name: tex
tex.synopsis: Texture node (request/response; block owns it), any node id usable as input/output node: kind in (adapter = '<adapter>:<name>', e.g. 'syphon:TouchDesigner'; legacy kind syphon + server) / draw (src gen ids or points = compute node id (count, instances for line/curve), brush look; inputs sampled as tex0(uv)..tex3(uv) in modifiers) / shader (wesl defines fn shade(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f, may import lygia::…; in0(uv)..in7(uv) sample inputs, info.time, info.size, param(i)) / compute (wesl fn compute(p: vec2u) -> vec4f and/or fn point(i: u32) -> Point with count; Point = struct over dims, DIM_<name> consts, src_point(i)/attr(i,k) read src gens; prev(i) -> Point needs pingpong; attrs={name: default} appends dims; brush modifiers read attr(info, DIM_<name>)) / feedback (1 input, asemic-repl trails) / ascii (1 input; luma per cell -> glyph of ramp (dark -> light), font ascii|asemic atlas, or atlas='text:<font path>' = font outlines filled at axes={tag: v} (routable via texparam / asemic/tex/<id>.param.<tag>; rebuilt on change + font hot-reload), ramp sorted by glyph coverage; params [columns, colour]); pingpong = keep last frame (self-inputs, cycles, smooth 0..1); params = up to 16 floats (texparam / asemic/tex/<id>.param.<i>); text = compute node: preview its sampled output values as a text grid (numbers) instead of the raster canvas; publish = sink addresses ('syphon' -> asemic:<id>); w h = 1280 720
tex.doc: Texture node (request/response; block owns it), any node id usable as input/output node: kind in (adapter = '<adapter>:<name>', e.g. 'syphon:TouchDesigner'; legacy kind syphon + server) / draw (src gen ids or points = compute node id (count, instances for line/curve), brush look; inputs sampled as tex0(uv)..tex3(uv) in modifiers) / shader (wesl defines fn shade(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f, may import lygia::…; in0(uv)..in7(uv) sample inputs, info.time, info.size, param(i)) / compute (wesl fn compute(p: vec2u) -> vec4f and/or fn point(i: u32) -> Point with count; Point = struct over dims, DIM_<name> consts, src_point(i)/attr(i,k) read src gens; prev(i) -> Point needs pingpong; attrs={name: default} appends dims; brush modifiers read attr(info, DIM_<name>)) / feedback (1 input, asemic-repl trails) / ascii (1 input; luma per cell -> glyph of ramp (dark -> light), font ascii|asemic atlas, or atlas='text:<font path>' = font outlines filled at axes={tag: v} (routable via texparam / asemic/tex/<id>.param.<tag>; rebuilt on change + font hot-reload), ramp sorted by glyph coverage; params [columns, colour]); pingpong = keep last frame (self-inputs, cycles, smooth 0..1); params = up to 16 floats (texparam / asemic/tex/<id>.param.<i>); text = compute node: preview its sampled output values as a text grid (numbers) instead of the raster canvas; publish = sink addresses ('syphon' -> asemic:<id>); w h = 1280 720

texparam.name: texparam
texparam.synopsis: Set texture node uniform param(i), or i = axis tag of an ascii text atlas (also Zenoh put asemic/tex/<id>.param.<i|tag>, JSON number; routable)
texparam.doc: Set texture node uniform param(i), or i = axis tag of an ascii text atlas (also Zenoh put asemic/tex/<id>.param.<i|tag>, JSON number; routable)

texs.name: texs
texs.synopsis: List texture nodes (+ dims = live point dims of draw/compute nodes)
texs.doc: List texture nodes (+ dims = live point dims of draw/compute nodes)

procs.name: procs
procs.synopsis: List procs: declared attrs {name: default} + live dims (point layout of asemic/gen/<id>)
procs.doc: List procs: declared attrs {name: default} + live dims (point layout of asemic/gen/<id>)

block.name: block
block.synopsis: No-op nest marker; `with block("name", timestretch=1.0):` scopes everything inside.
block.doc:
No-op nest marker; `with block("name", timestretch=1.0):` scopes everything inside.
timestretch: 1.0 real-time, 0.0 frozen (default), >1 faster, <0 reverse.
loop: loop (default), off, pingpong.

embed.name: embed
embed.synopsis: Link row to node `id` (click = jump to its row) + that node's own built-in preview.
embed.doc:
Link row to node `id` (click = jump to its row) + that node's own built-in preview.
preview: dots|image|ascii.

affinity.name: affinity
affinity.synopsis: Renderer row: draws gen on input in Affinity Designer document.
affinity.doc:
Renderer row: draws gen on input in Affinity Designer document.
preview: image|dots|ascii.
notes: tuple of layers ('heads', 'stems', 'lines', 'accidentals', 'names'), or preset 'notes'.
names: 'pitchclass'|'midi'|'hz'|'notename'|'note'.
settings: layout knobs {'spacing': 1.0, 'quarter_in': 0.25}.

sc.name: sc
sc.synopsis: SuperCollider synth row: evaluated as Ndef(<id>).
sc.doc:
SuperCollider synth row: evaluated as Ndef(<id>).
params passed as keyword arguments.

orca.name: orca
orca.synopsis: No-op marker: an Orca grid literal; the orca adapter process owns the grid.
orca.doc: No-op marker: an Orca grid literal; the orca adapter process owns the grid.

physics.name: physics
physics.synopsis: Rapier2d balls in a unit box (processor -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id>).
physics.doc:
Rapier2d balls in a unit box (processor -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id>).
n: ball count (default 8.0). gravity: (default 1.0). restitution: (default 0.9). radius: (default 0.04).
kick: (default 0.0). damping: (default 0.0). angular_damping: (default 0.0).

wave.name: wave
wave.doc:
1D stationary Schrödinger (schrodinger_equation, Numerov) solver.
energy: (default 0.5). k: (default 1.0). mass: (default 1.0). span: (default 5.0).

spectrum.name: spectrum
spectrum.synopsis: FFT bands of input stream (processor -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id>).
spectrum.doc:
FFT bands of input stream (processor -> asemic/value/<id>.<channel> + asemic/gen/<id>).
input: key (io stream e.g. 'asemic/io/mic/in' / 'chaos:x'). gain: (default 1.0).

glyph.name: glyph
glyph.synopsis: Text as asemic font paths, scanned/wobbled by params.
glyph.doc:
Text as asemic font paths, scanned/wobbled by params.
text: glyph text string. size: (default 0.08). rotate: (default 0.0). spacing: (default 0.15).
wobble: (default 0.0). speed: (default 1.0). scan: (default 0.0). x: (default 0.5). y: (default 0.5).

lsys.name: lsys
lsys.synopsis: L-system (symbios derivation + turtle), optionally rooted on input gen points.
lsys.doc:
L-system (symbios derivation + turtle), optionally rooted on input gen points.
axiom: starting string (default 'F'). rules: string e.g. '0.5: F -> F[+F]F; ...'.
n: iterations (default 4.0). angle: turning angle (default 25.0). step: (default 0.02).
growth: (default 1.0). width: (default 1.0). stride: (default 1.0). scale: (default 1.0).

text.name: text
text.synopsis: Text shaped (harfbuzz) in font path, outlines (skrifa) at axis params, flattened (lyon).
text.doc:
Text shaped (harfbuzz) in font path, outlines (skrifa) at axis params, flattened (lyon).
path: font file path (hot reload). text: string. size: (default 0.2). tol: (default 0.001).
x: (default 0.1). y: (default 0.6).

melody.name: melody
melody.synopsis: Seeded pentatonic walk: 1 line per voice, 1 point per note, dims pitch (MIDI) + dur (beats).
melody.doc:
Seeded pentatonic walk: 1 line per voice, 1 point per note, dims pitch (MIDI) + dur (beats).
voices: (default 2.0). base: MIDI note (default 72.0). beats: length (default 32.0).
step: max degree steps per move (default 2.0). slow: octave step multiplier (default 2.0).

py.name: py
py.synopsis: Python proc evaluated in REPL: `py(id, fn="./fn", p={...}, input=<gen>)` where block-scoped stringpath `fn` returns points.
py.doc:
Python proc evaluated in REPL: `py(id, fn="./fn", p={...}, input=<gen>)` where block-scoped stringpath `fn` returns points.
Brain queries params + input gen on change, caches reply.
